title: Changelog
text: New episodes input table (person_id, start_episode, end_episode), passed argument define_window()/anchor()/anchor_by_variable()/anchor_by_selector(). anchoR now nests onto population internally (nest_episodes_onto_population()); caller longer builds manages nested list-column hand. Four episode-based constructors replacing removed ones: in_current_pregnancy, in_prior_pregnancy, in_current_and_prior (new union two), outside_all_pregnancy. four share one engine, pregnancy_window_engine(). classify_episodes(): labels person’s episodes "current"/"prior"/"future" relative anchor date. Prior/future relative current episode’s bounds one exists; current episode, fall back relative anchor date directly instead. episode_windows(): new border-offset formula turning selected episode one windows. Six new metadata columns replace everything removed columns used : anchor_start_offset/anchor_end_offset (see clip_to_anchor_bounds() ) two offset pairs, before_start_episode_offset/after_start_episode_offset before_end_episode_offset/after_end_episode_offset, relative selected episode’s start/end. before_start_episode_offset after_end_episode_offset “outer” sides (pointing away episode); after_start_episode_offset before_end_episode_offset “inner” sides (pointing ). pair’s contribution decided independently: pair sides set (“full”) always self-contained region, [edge + before_offset, edge + after_offset] (inverted pair, before_*_offset later after_*_offset, error), never suppresses whatever pair independently contributes. non-full pair whose set side outer one pulls whole computation shared-window mode, every non-full pair contributes one point (one set side, unshifted edge empty) single shared window; full pair sits shared window, keeping region alongside instead. Outside shared-window mode, non-full pair inner side set forms region instead, missing side defaulting 0; empty pair contributes nothing. Neither pair set falls back episode’s unshifted span. See documentation/definitions/Episode-Based Window Engine.md complete rule worked examples. clip_to_anchor_bounds(): anchor_start_offset/anchor_end_offset hard boundary, [anchor_start_col + anchor_start_offset, anchor_end_col + anchor_end_offset], applied every episode-based constructor’s output, just outside_all_pregnancy’s search range. side clips independently NA: set anchor_start_offset raises window’s start boundary’s lower edge, set anchor_end_offset lowers end boundary’s upper edge. window entirely outside boundary comes invalid, empty window, rather erroring. outside_all_pregnancy clip -op (search range already boundary); three constructors ’s new, independent mechanism top border-offset formula e.g. “episode-based window may extend outside [T0 - 1, T0 + 1],” regardless border offsets otherwise produce. make_selector(): define custom selector (SQL SELECT statement) script, resolved naming convention (<NAME> metadata value → <name>_selector object) exactly way make_constructor() already resolved custom constructors. Supporting internals: selector_object_name(), selector_is_resolvable(), resolve_selector_sql(), selector_sql_exists(), read_builtin_selector_sql(). read_selector_sql_query()/run_selector_query()/run_selector_queries() gain selector_env argument (default globalenv()) selector name can resolve either bundled inst/sql/*.sql template caller-defined make_selector() object. vignettes/custom-selectors.Rmd: worked example make_selector(), alongside existing custom-constructors vignette. documentation/Quickstart.md: zero-jargon quickstart assuming prior familiarity R epidemiology vocabulary anchoR uses (T0, window, concept, selector, constructor), linked README documentation/README.md. CONTRIBUTING.md: dev setup, local inner loop, four CI workflows (testthat, r_cmd_check, code_quality, test_coverage) actually checks, add built-constructor selector package . documentation/definitions/Episodes.md, IN_CURRENT_PREG.md, IN_CURRENT_AND_PRIOR.md: new definitions pages new table constructors. validate_variable_ids control values variable_id, crucial path formation.

code: library(anchoR) library(data.table)  # Step 1: who are we asking about, and what's their T0? population <- data.table(   person_id = c("1", "2"),   T0        = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-01")) )  # Step 2: what do we want to know? # "Was there a flu vaccine in the 365 days up to and including T0? #  If there's more than one, give me the most recent." metadata <- data.table(   variable_id  = "flu_vaccine_recent",   concept_id   = "FLU_VAX",   constructor  = "GENERIC",   # a fixed window around T0   selector     = "LATEST",    # the most recent matching record   start_offset = -365L,       # 365 days before T0 ...   end_offset   = 0L           # ... through T0 itself )  # Step 3: the raw data to search through. concepts <- data.table(   person_id  = "1",   concept_id = "FLU_VAX",   date       = as.Date("2023-10-01"),   value      = "TRUE" )  # Run it. Results are written to a folder ("hive_path"), not returned directly. hive_path <- tempfile(pattern = "anchor-hive-") dir.create(hive_path)  anchor(population, metadata, concepts, anchor_hive_path = hive_path)  # Read the results back. get_anchor_result(metadata, hive_path, result_shape = "long") #>    person_id         T0        variable_id window_name       date value #> 1:         1 2024-01-01 flu_vaccine_recent        <NA> 2023-10-01  TRUE

FALSE (default), results cast person_id + T0 + window_name ~ variable_id. TRUE, results cast person_id + T0 ~ window_name + variable_id. only_date Logical; TRUE result_shape = "wide", date columns cast (value_<...> columns). FALSE, value date columns cast. required_population_cols Character vector column names must present population data frame provided. Defaults c("person_id", "T0").
